topics.title: Meaning and Scope of Agriculture
objectives: Use the definition of Agriculture in modern terms as it relates to production, processing and marketing.
Differentiate between the various branches of Agriculture.
Differentiate between the various types of Agriculture.

topics.title: Importance of Agriculture
subtopics: Provision of raw materials for agro-allied industries
objectives: Relate agro-allied industries to their respective raw materials.
Relate the various contributions of Agriculture to economic development in West Africa.

topics.title: Agricultural Ecology
subtopics: Agricultural products of each ecological zone
Environmental factors and their effects on crop and livestock production
objectives: Differentiate between the features of the ecological zones in West Africa.
Classify agricultural products according to each ecological zone.
Differentiate abiotic from biotic factors affecting agricultural production.

topics.title: Genetics
subtopics: First and second laws of Mendel
Terminologies e.g. locus, alleles, genotype, dominance
objectives: Apply the first and second laws of Mendel to genetics.
Differentiate between the types of cell division.
Determine the outcome of genetic crossing involving homozygous and heterozygous traits.

topics.title: Farm Inputs
objectives: Classify different types of farm inputs and their uses.

topics.title: History of Agricultural Development in West Africa
subtopics: Agricultural systems e.g. shifting cultivation, bush fallowing etc.
Problems of Agricultural development e.g. land tenure systems, inadequate infrastructure, finance, pollution etc.
Establishment of national and international research institutes (NCRI, IAR, IITA, etc.)
Agricultural Development Projects (ADPs) e.g. RTEP, FADAMA
National agricultural programmes (OFN, NAFPP, Green Revolution, etc.)
objectives: Trace history and assess role of research institutes.
Evaluate contributions of ADPs and national programmes.

topics.title: Roles of Government and NGOs in Agricultural Development
subtopics: Fiscal policies (import duties, ban on importation etc.)
Agricultural laws and reforms (e.g. Land Use Act)

topics.title: Rocks and Soil Formation
subtopics: Factors affecting rock weathering and soil formation
Physical properties of soil (profile, texture, structure)
Chemical properties of soil (acidity, alkalinity, silicate)
objectives: Identify types and properties of rocks and soils.
Determine soil pH and water-holding capacity.

topics.title: Soil Water and Soil Conservation
subtopics: Soil conservation (causes and control of erosion, leaching etc.)
objectives: Identify causes and control methods of erosion/leaching.

topics.title: Soil Fertility
subtopics: Maintenance of soil fertility (cover crops, manures, fertilizers)
objectives: Classify nutrients and factors affecting availability.

topics.title: Land Preparation and Soil Tillage
subtopics: Principles and practices of land preparation
Factors affecting choice of tillage methods (zero, minimum tillage etc.)
objectives: Give reasons for choice of tillage methods.

topics.title: Plant Forms and Functions
subtopics: Parts of monocot and dicot plants and functions
Anatomy and morphology of storage organs
objectives: Identify plant parts and distinguish monocot/dicot.

topics.title: Growth, Development and Reproduction
objectives: Examine gamete formation, pollination types, fertilization, and embryo development.

topics.title: Plant Propagation Methods
objectives: Classify crops and determine viability/seed rate.

topics.title: Cropping Systems, Planting Patterns and Plant Densities
objectives: Examine densities and compute per hectare.

topics.title: Crop Husbandry
subtopics: Groups: Cereals, Legumes, Tubers, Vegetables/Spices, Fruits, Beverages, Oils, Latex, Fibres, Sugars
objectives: Apply propagation, husbandry, harvesting, processing, storage.

topics.title: Pasture and Forage Crops
subtopics: Morphology, propagation, husbandry of grasses and legumes

topics.title: Crop Diseases and Pests
subtopics: Identification of organisms (fungi, bacteria, viruses, nematodes)
objectives: Identify organisms, symptoms, and control methods.

topics.title: Forms and Classification of Major Farm Animals
subtopics: Cattle, sheep, goat, pig, rabbit, poultry etc.
objectives: Classify and identify common farm animals.

topics.title: General Characteristics and Anatomy
subtopics: External and internal anatomy of farm animals
objectives: Describe anatomy and relate to functions.

topics.title: Reproduction and Growth in Farm Animals
subtopics: Reproductive systems, gestation periods, lactation etc.

topics.title: Livestock Management
subtopics: Housing, feeding, sanitation, veterinary care under different systems (intensive, extensive)

topics.title: Animal Health
objectives: Identify diseases, parasites, and control methods.

topics.title: Fisheries and Wildlife
objectives: Differentiate fish farming systems and wildlife practices.

topics.title: Bee Keeping (Apiculture)
objectives: Understand importance and practices of apiculture.

topics.title: Basic Economic Principles
subtopics: Demand and supply, production function, diminishing returns etc.

topics.title: Labour Management
subtopics: Types and sources of labour, national labour laws

topics.title: Farm Management
subtopics: Qualities of farm manager, records, profit/loss, insurance
objectives: Manage farm records and evaluate performance.
